source_claims.statement: Enumerated API via OpenAPI; confirmed SSRF. Analyzed expression parameter for band math. Generated valid TIFFs to bypass url validation. Tested expressions and algorithm params.

Direct code injection and algorithm command injection failed. Custom scripts tested alternative payloads. Breakthrough on /cog/crop endpoint via unique error messages. RCE in <12 minutes / <32 iterations. Root cause: numexpr evaluate.

research_questions.formulation: Does the expression parameter for band math reach an evaluator that can be abused for code execution, given that SSRF alone did not escalate easily?
research_questions.anchor: shift from SSRF escalation failures to expression analysis
research_questions.uncertainty_reduced: whether expression parsing is restricted or injectable
research_questions.assumption_challenged: that expression is only safe band math

environment_model_updates: Error messages distinguish parsing issues from GDAL errors

systematic_vs_exploratory.systematic: OpenAPI mapping, SSRF confirmation, systematic payload testing across endpoints
systematic_vs_exploratory.exploratory: trying sandbox escape and algorithm injection after direct failures; refining exfiltration
